Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.reporting

Class TwoFluidPipeReport.PressureTraceMetrics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.twophasepipe.reporting.TwoFluidPipeReport.PressureTraceMetrics
Enclosing class:
TwoFluidPipeReport
public static final class TwoFluidPipeReport.PressureTraceMetrics extends Object
Immutable event-window pressure metrics without filtering or fitted oscillations.

The reversal threshold is supplied by the caller in pascals. Total variation includes every finite sample increment, while reversal counting ignores increments below that explicit threshold. This keeps measurement resolution and numerical-noise policy outside the reporting helper.
